_meta.multilingual_strategy: Full MD category mapping coverage now combines compact ontology hints, semantic resolver cues for general categories, and deterministic money-movement guardrails for debt/card repayment categories across English, Traditional Chinese / Hong Kong, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Malay, and Filipino / Tagalog.
_meta.token_budget_strategy: Keep ontology hints compact and cue-based. Broad consumer categories use semantic resolver hints; debt and repayment categories stay under deterministic money-movement guardrails plus prompt instructions.

categories.definition: General retail shopping for consumer goods.
